courses.title: MPH Global Public Health
courses.overview: Advanced public health degree with a core focus on global disease prevention.
courses.modules: Epidemiology, Global Health Policy, Biostatistics, Promotion

courses.title: BSc (Hons) Veterinary Nursing
courses.overview: Professional training for RCVS registration as a veterinary nurse.
courses.modules: Animal Anatomy, Clinical Skills, Diagnostics, Nursing Care

courses.title: MSc Data Science
courses.overview: Analyzing large datasets for business intelligence and industrial application.
courses.modules: Big Data, Statistical Modelling, Data Mining, Python

courses.title: Master of Public Health (MPH)
courses.overview: Addressing global health challenges and population-based healthcare strategy.
courses.modules: Epidemiology, Global Health Policy, Biostatistics, Promotion

courses.title: BSc (Hons) Marine Biology with Conservation
courses.overview: Focused on aquatic biodiversity and the protection of marine ecosystems.
courses.modules: Marine Ecology, Oceanography, Conservation Policy, Aquatic Biology

courses.title: BSc (Hons) Ecology and Conservation
courses.overview: Focusing on ecosystem management and solving local and global biodiversity crises.
courses.modules: Field Ecology, GIS, Biodiversity Management, Climate Change

courses.title: BSc (Hons) Nursing (Mental Health)
courses.overview: Focusing on the delivery of evidence-based care for individuals with mental illness.
courses.modules: Psychiatric Nursing, Pharmacology, Ethics, Crisis Management

courses.title: MSc Child and Adolescent Mental Wellbeing
courses.overview: Exploring interventions for child and youth mental health challenges.
courses.modules: Youth Mental Health, Intervention Design, Research Methods

courses.title: MSc Horticulture
courses.overview: Technical and commercial management of horticultural production and landscaping.
courses.modules: Plant Science, Urban Horticulture, Commercial Management

courses.title: BSc (Hons) Computing and Information Systems
courses.overview: Bridging the gap between technical computing and business information management.
courses.modules: Systems Analysis, Network Security, IT Management, Database Design

courses.title: BA (Hons) Music Performance
courses.overview: Focused on technical mastery and professional performance in a variety of genres.
courses.modules: Solo Performance, Composition, Music Theory, Music Industry

courses.title: BA (Hons) Politics
courses.overview: Examines the structures of power, political theory, and the functioning of global and domestic governments.
courses.modules: Political Theory, Comparative Politics, Modern Systems, Policy

courses.title: BA (Hons) International Relations
courses.overview: Analyzes global security, diplomacy, and the political interactions between states.
courses.modules: World Politics, Security Studies, Diplomacy, Global Governance

courses.title: BA (Hons) Early Childhood Studies (Graduate Practitioner)
courses.overview: Focused on the development, learning, and care of children from birth to age eight.
courses.modules: Child Development, Early Years Policy, Inclusion, Play and Learning

courses.title: BA (Hons) Social Work
courses.overview: Professional training for registration as a social worker with Social Work England.
courses.modules: Social Work Law, Human Growth, Practice Placement, Ethics

courses.title: BSc (Hons) Nursing (Children)
courses.overview: Leading to NMC registration as a children's nurse; focusing on the care of young people.
courses.modules: Child Physiology, Family-Centred Care, Clinical Skills, Pharmacology

courses.title: BA (Hons) 3D Animation
courses.overview: Technical art and animation for film, television, and game cinematics.
courses.modules: 3D Modelling, Compositing, Character Rigging, VFX Pipelines
